description: Main source file for a USB-C port power management application using Zephyr RTOS, implementing port data handling, callback registration, and power state transitions.

methods.name: dump_sink_request_rdo
methods.description: Logs detailed information about a sink request RDO.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_get_src_rp
methods.description: Callback to get the source Rp value.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_src_en
methods.description: Callback to enable or disable the power supply.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_vconn_en
methods.description: Callback to enable or disable VCONN.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_check_sink_request
methods.description: Verifies if a sink request is valid.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_is_ps_ready
methods.description: Checks if power supply is ready.

methods.name: port0_policy_cb_present_contract_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the present contract is still valid.

methods.name: port0_notify
methods.description: Handles policy notifications from the port.

methods.name: port0_policy_check
methods.description: Performs policy checks such as role swaps and power levels.
